name: Ramalingaswami Re-entry Research Programme (formerly Ramalingaswami Re-entry Fellowship, RRF)
funder: Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Government of India
amount: Rs 1,35,000/month consolidated + Rs 13 lakh/year research support grant + Rs 50,000/year overhead to host
other_rules: upper age limit 45 years on the closing date
at least 3 years of postdoctoral research experience in overseas laboratories (min_years_since_phd is used as a proxy)
must currently work overseas, or have returned to India within 1 year of the closing date (2 years for women) without holding a permanent position
research areas: life sciences, biotechnology, bioengineering, human/animal health, agricultural/veterinary biotechnology, bioenergy and allied areas
notes: Dates are from the 2024-25 call (opened 28 Jan 2025, closed 28 Feb 2025, extended to 15 Mar 2025); no new call announced as of 8 Oct 2026. Renamed "Research Programme" by DBT notice of 17 Jun 2026, with no change to eligibility or funding. 3 years, extendable by 2 years after fresh appraisal (up to 60 months). Managed by DBT-HRD PMU at RCB Faridabad (rrf.dbt@rcb.res.in). On taking a permanent post the fellowship component stops but the research grant continues.

documents.name: Undertaking / statement from current employer
documents.notes: Certifies the applicant does not hold a permanent position in India, if applicable
